name: Dramabox
access: Hugging Face weights ResembleAI/Dramabox (an audio-only 3.3B diffusion transformer, adapted with an IC-LoRA from LTX-2.3)

voice.input_audio: A scene description in plain English: stage directions outside quotation marks and spoken lines inside double quotation marks; optional reference clip of 10 seconds or more (3 to 30 seconds are used) [hf-dramabox]
voice.output_audio: A wav file written by the inference script, with the Perth watermark on by default; the pages read state no sample rate [hf-dramabox]
voice.voices: custom cloning from a 10-second clip; without a clip the model picks a voice that fits the description [hf-dramabox]
voice.turn_detection: none: a synthesis model; a prompt can hold several lines and several speakers as a scene [hf-dramabox]
voice.latency: Resemble AI: about 2.5 seconds per generation on an H100 once the server is warm; this is whole-generation time, not time to first audio [hf-dramabox]
voice.session_limit: Duration is estimated from the prompt, with a setting to fix it; the card suggests 20 to 60 seconds for music or long scenes [hf-dramabox]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Open weights under the LTX-2 Community License (licence date 2026-01-05). The licence allows use for any purpose under its use restrictions, but an entity with annual revenue of US$10,000,000 or more needs a paid commercial licence from Lightricks [hf-dramabox-license]. About 24 GB of GPU memory at peak with a warm server, plus an 8 GB 4-bit text encoder that downloads at first run [hf-dramabox]
